works.body:
◆Request Summary: Illustration of Original Character ◆Character Traits Lloyd D. Archer https://xfolio.jp/portfolio/kureeeeenai/works/5270827 An expressive 14-year-old boy. He's somewhat cocky and fiercely righteous, with a sharp tongue but a kind heart. Slightly lean. Often wears a confident expression. His droopy eyes give him a gentle impression.


　Toey Aufraut https://xfolio.jp/portfolio/kureeeeenai/works/5270881 A handsome young man with the pride of a dragon clan and the dignity of nobility, possessing a somewhat intimidating appearance. He enjoys fashion, customizing his uniform and wearing accessories, which, combined with his face and build, often leads people to mistake him for a delinquent. He says things like, "Half-asses deserve to die, but dying in front of me ruins my morning," yet he shields such half-asses and cleans up after Lloyd's fights, revealing glimpses of his kindness. ・Their Relationship: Though they differ in status and race—noble and commoner, dragonkin and human—they are each other's best friends. Toyi looks out for Lloyd, stopping him when he's reckless and offering advice.
　They joke around like, "Fell for my face?" "Yeah, where should we have the wedding?" They're close, belonging to the same club, sitting next to each other in class, and such. They also argue over their differing views on status: "If Lloyd had a title, he'd be a match for the Third Princess!" "Mind your own business!"


・World Setting: A magical world set in early modern Europe (around 1850). The cityscapes resemble Brooklyn, New York, and towns along the Hudson River. It's a common early modern European-style alternate world. Many races exist, including beastfolk and dragonkin. Both are students, so they primarily live school lives.

◆Composition & Details: I leave all expressions, compositions, etc., entirely up to you. Please keep the characters' defining features—blonde hair/eyes and brown hair/green eyes—unchanged, but feel free to modify clothing, hairstyles, etc. https://xfolio.jp/portfolio/kureeeeenai/free/1362429
